141:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is it?! I only meant to celebrate our reunion...」

141:t_10:35.en:
$$五飛$$
「I just can't trust you... Stay away from me.」

141:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I know, you see. Even as you say that, $$五飛$$, you can't completely reject me.」

141:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I don't know what $$五飛$$, who can sniff out justice and evil by instinct, senses in me, but please remember just this.」

141:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Staking your life and throwing your life away are alike, yet different.」

141:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, you surely learned that living is itself the fight.」

141:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please, survive. Together with $$ナタク$$, for the sake of the precious people who entrusted their hopes to you.」

141:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeblood. But if I have overstepped, I will accept whatever scolding you see fit.」

141:t_10:46.en:
$$五飛$$
「No, it's fine... You have my thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.」

141:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that you're $$ナタク$$-convinced, let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

141:t_10:48.en:
$$五飛$$
「As I thought, you can't be trusted!」

142:t_000:0.en:
$$五飛$$
(...The retreat was in time. From here, $$ロジャー$$ and the others will lead them to join up with $$ゼロ$$'s main force...)

142:t_000:1.en:
$$五飛$$
(...Leave the rest to me. I'll stake my life to protect your pride.)

142:t_000:2.en:
$$五飛$$
(The Miracle of $$厳島$$... I don't know how much one man alone can do, but I'll do everything I can.)

142:t_000:3.en:
$$五飛$$
($$トレーズ$$... I've fought on, believing that living and continuing to fight is justice...)

142:t_000:4.en:
$$五飛$$
(But today, I stake everything. This is the place for me to die, after all my wavering, erring and wandering.)

142:t_000:5.en:
$$五飛$$
(I'll carry hope to tomorrow with my life...! To build true peace in this world...!)

142:t_001:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「An advance squad, huh... A bit unsatisfying for my last opponent...」

142:t_002:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Let's do it, $$ナタク$$! I'll burn my life out right here!」

142:t_002:1.en:
???
「Quit trying to look cool all by yourself.」

142:t_003:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$竜馬$$...! And $$ロジャー$$ and $$キリコ$$ too...!」

142:t_003:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I've left guiding the troops to $$ノーマン$$. No need to worry.」

142:t_003:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Since the mission is done, I'll do as I please from here.」

142:t_003:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A glorious death in battle would surely become legend, but it leaves sorrow for those left behind.」

142:t_003:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Protecting this planet is reason enough to fight. I'm not about to go avenging you, either.」

142:t_003:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're a straight-laced man. I could tell you were looking for a chance to atone for the last war.」

142:t_003:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't cling to pointless stubbornness. It's hard on the ones watching.」

142:t_003:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we're doing this, a miracle comeback beats a suicide charge. With you, the $$異能生存体$$, a man back from $$陰月$$ and a silver-tongued world-saver, nothing's impossible.」

142:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A few of those phrasings snagged on me, but that's the idea.」

142:t_003:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「...Sorry. I may have been about to go down the wrong road again.」

142:t_003:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let's call it even between us, no debts. After all, from here on we live or die together.」

142:t_003:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do this, Captain! Fire us up with a good rousing speech!」

142:t_003:14.en:
$$五飛$$
($$黎星刻$$... Just as you said, in the midst of battle I gained a treasure in my comrades...)

142:t_004:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「We'll bring about the Miracle of $$厳島$$ again with our own hands! But I won't allow a single one of you to die!」

142:t_004:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「Living is the fight! We will seize victory without fail!」

142:t_005:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「These guys were only testing us, after all. The main force is waiting behind them.」

142:t_005:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on...! The real fight starts once they get here!」

142:t_005:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I know...! The second wave is coming...!」

142:t_006:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The $$アストラギウス$$ bunch... So they got themselves hired by $$サイデリアル$$!」

142:t_006:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Be careful! They're not the only reinforcements!」

142:t_007:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$連邦軍$$...!」

142:t_007:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This timing... It doesn't look like the $$ジオン$$ guys are planning to ride $$サイデリアル$$'s coattails to take down $$新日本$$.」

142:t_007:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And the $$連邦軍$$ are probably not here to intercept them, either.」

142:t_008:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and the others have arrived too.」

142:t_008:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$五飛$$...! What is the meaning of this...!?」

142:t_008:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ and part of the $$連邦軍$$ have sided with $$サイデリアル$$!」

142:t_008:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$...! Is that you, $$ギュネイ$$!」

142:t_008:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Has $$ネオ・ジオン$$ gone over to the Empire!?」

142:t_008:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「All units, begin the attack. Taking down this base is our mission.」

142:t_008:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「Pathetic... Did you throw away your pride just to survive?」

142:t_008:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, give the order to intercept!」

142:t_008:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Since they're coming at us, it makes no difference whether they're $$ジオン$$ or Federation! Don't let them through!」

142:t_008:14.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... the $$地球連邦$$... Is this the future of $$ジオン$$ that man has in mind...」

142:t_008:15.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$竜馬$$, $$ロジャー$$, $$キリコ$$! Regroup!」

142:t_009:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like $$五飛$$ has been doing a proper job as commander.」

142:t_009:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Only he could have played this role.」

142:t_009:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. He knows the true meaning of fighting now.」

142:t_009:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Let's go. To protect the Miracle of $$厳島$$, too.」

142:t_009:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「You who went over to the Empire! Know that you, who threw away your pride, have no future!」

142:t_010:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Still, I can't bring myself to celebrate this victory without reservation...」

142:t_010:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Yes... Not only has the collusion between $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ that we feared been confirmed, but...」
